question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Aggravate
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Aggravate"** means to make a problem or situation worse or more severe. (बिगाड़ना)

 
 
• **Example: **His constant complaints only served to** aggravate** the situation.
 
 
 
• **"Alleviate"** means to make a problem or suffering less severe. (कम करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The doctor gave me some medicine to alleviate the pain.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Aggravate'** is **'Alleviate'**.

Therefore, the correct antonym of **'Aggravate'** is '**Alleviate'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Exasperate** (ख़फ़ा करना): To irritate or annoy someone intensely.

 
 
• **Example:** His constant interruptions **exasperate** me.
 
 
 
• **Humiliate** (अपमानित करना): To make someone feel ashamed or foolish by injuring their dignity and self-respect.
 
 
• **Example: **She felt **humiliated** by the teacher's scolding in front of the whole class.
 
 
 
• **Ignorant** (अज्ञानी): Lacking knowledge, awareness, or education.
 
 
• **Example:** He was** ignorant **of the rules of the game.
